findings.evidence: mathlib/Mathlib/GroupTheory/PresentedGroup.lean:47 `def mk (rels) : FreeGroup α →* PresentedGroup rels := ⟨⟨QuotientGroup.mk, rfl⟩, fun _ _ => rfl⟩`; :78 `lemma mk_eq_mk_of_mul_inv_mem (hx : x * y⁻¹ ∈ rels) : mk rels x = mk rels y`.
findings.fix: Keep `PresentedGroup.mk` as a hom: add `theorem sigma_eq_mk (i) : sigma i = PresentedGroup.mk (artinRelations n) (FreeGroup.of i) := rfl`, rewrite with it, and use `map_mul`/`map_inv` on `mk` directly. For `braid_rel` the relator is literally `x * y⁻¹`, so `PresentedGroup.mk_eq_mk_of_mul_inv_mem (ArtinRelation.braid i j h)` gives the statement after `simp [sigma_eq_mk, map_mul]`; `comm` follows the same way modulo one `mul_assoc`.
findings.issue: `comm` (line 107) and `braid_rel` (line 120) both do `dsimp [sigma, PresentedGroup.of, PresentedGroup.mk] at h1 ⊢`, unfolding the body of Mathlib's `PresentedGroup.mk` (a bundled `MonoidHom`, defined as `⟨⟨QuotientGroup.mk, rfl⟩, fun _ _ => rfl⟩`) so that the following `rw [map_mul, …]` chain applies. The proofs then depend on that internal representation rather than on the hom API.

findings.evidence: Lines 203–210 of the new file; rubric flags `change`/`show` without a documenting comment.
findings.fix: Replace the `let`s with `set a : Fin n := ⟨i.1, hi⟩ with ha` (etc.), which abstracts hypotheses and goal together, or state `hab`/`hbc`/`hac` in terms of `a`, `b`, `c` after introducing them. If any `change` survives, add a comment saying why no rewrite reaches the goal.
findings.issue: Four undocumented `change` steps: `change Equiv.swap a b * … = …` (206) and `change a ≠ b at hab` / `change b ≠ c at hbc` / `change a ≠ c at hac` (208–210). They exist only to fold the `let a/b/c` bindings introduced on 203–205, i.e. they rely on the definitional unfolding of the `let`s.

findings.evidence: Mathlib has only `Equiv.swap_mul_swap_mul_swap` (mathlib/Mathlib/Algebra/Group/End.lean:579), not this symmetric form, so the fact is genuinely reusable and currently hidden.
findings.fix: Extract `theorem Equiv.swap_braid {α} [DecidableEq α] {a b c : α} (hab : a ≠ b) (hbc : b ≠ c) (hac : a ≠ c) : swap a b * swap b c * swap a b = swap b c * swap a b * swap b c` (proved by the current calc) and a companion commuting-swaps lemma; `permHom_rel` then reduces to two applications.
findings.issue: The `calc` on 211–218 proves a general fact about transpositions — `swap a b * swap b c * swap a b = swap b c * swap a b * swap b c` for pairwise-distinct `a b c` — inline inside `permHom_rel`, as does the disjointness argument on 180–188. `permHom_rel` is a 48-line two-branch proof whose structure is entirely obscured by this.

findings.evidence: `Fin.ne_of_val_ne` is in use in Mathlib, e.g. mathlib/Mathlib/RingTheory/Polynomial/Resultant/Basic.lean:101.
findings.fix: Use `Fin.ne_of_val_ne (by omega)` for the disequalities, and factor the bound boilerplate into a `def strand (i : Fin (n - 1)) : Fin n := ⟨i.1, by omega⟩` / `strandSucc` pair (or `Fin.castLE`) used by `permGen`, `permHom_sigma`, `castSuccGen`, and `castSuccHom_sigma`.
findings.issue: Seven near-identical `Fin` disequality proofs written as `intro h_eq; injection h_eq with hv; omega` (180, 182, 184, 186 in the comm branch; 194, 196, 198 in the braid branch), plus twelve copies of `by have hlt := i.is_lt; omega` for the `i.1 < n` / `i.1 + 1 < n` bounds (167, 168, 176–179, 191–193, 229, 230, 240, 262).

findings.evidence: mathlib/Mathlib/GroupTheory/FreeGroup/Basic.lean:665 `def Lift.aux : List (α × Bool) → β := fun L => …` (auxiliary for `lift`, only used internally at :680–684); the public interface is `lift_mk` at :689.
findings.fix: Define `evalWord w : BraidGroup n := FreeGroup.lift sigma (FreeGroup.mk w)`. Then `evalWord_nil` is `simp`, `evalWord_append` follows from `FreeGroup.mul_mk` and `map_mul`, and `evalWord_cons` from `FreeGroup.lift_mk` — no unfolding of an internal definition.
findings.issue: `evalWord` is defined through Mathlib's internal helper `FreeGroup.Lift.aux`, so all three lemmas must unfold it: `evalWord_nil` is `dsimp [evalWord, FreeGroup.Lift.aux]; rfl` (130–131), and `evalWord_cons`/`evalWord_append` `simp [evalWord, FreeGroup.Lift.aux, …]` (136, 141). `Lift.aux` has no lemma API, so these proofs depend on its body and on a bare `rfl`.

summary: Several proofs work by unfolding Mathlib internals (`PresentedGroup.mk`, `FreeGroup.Lift.aux`) instead of the available API, and `permHom_rel` carries undocumented `change` steps plus an inline general `Equiv.swap` identity that belongs in its own lemma.
